headline: The design and the running system are separate claims.
lede: The current reference is useful today, while several parts of the organizational promise remain design direction rather than enforced behavior.
rows: Distinct agent identities and attributed writes are in use
Every action binds the acting role to the person it represents
Declared workflows and review gates run across repository work
Any kind of work moves through the same durable organization
Some consequential actions already stop for approval
Every action is checked against explicit, revocable authority
The public reference assumes one operator
Several accountable people share roles, delegation, and approval
